---
name: Good first issue
about: A small, well-defined task suitable for a first-time contributor (usually created by maintainers)
title: "[Good first issue] "
labels: good first issue
---

**The task**
A short, specific description of what needs to change.

**Why**
One or two sentences on why it's worth doing.

**Where to look**
Files or areas of the code involved (paths help a lot).

**How to check it works**
How the contributor can confirm their change is correct.

**Good to know**
Any hints, links, or gotchas. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started and [docs/setup.md](../../docs/setup.md) to run the app.
